items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] He and Johnny Dodds, huh, both? ... [INTERVIEWEE] That's right.

ctx.x: Who was in the Eagle band? Frankie Dusen? King Oliver? King Oliver? How do you call him? That fellow again? Oh, I was shocked. As good as I knew him. Because Frankie was playing trombone you see, and King Oliver playing trumpet. And this guy? Johnny, you remember Johnny? Johnny? What did he play? Bass. Johnny Brown. Don't you remember Johnny Brown? I never knew him. Oh, that guy could play that bass. My dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
Did they have a good drummer, a good banjo player, a guitar player? Who was playing drums?
